mechanism: {{system}} 2 {{simulation}}. {{agent}} constructs a causal graph of the target system. It executes a 'Dry Run' of the proposed plan within that graph, inside an isolated {{agent_sandbox}}, to predict {{state}}(t+1) — toggling between fast {{heuristic_snap}} and rigorous {{deep}} simulation modes.
failure_modes: Map-Territory Error: {{simulation}} diverges from reality (Hallucinated Physics).
Overconfidence: {{agent}} trusts the simulation execution log more than real-world feedback.
invariants: Builds a causal graph of the target {{system}} before running anything.
The {{simulation}} produces no side effects in the production context.
Costs at most `cost_fraction` of executing the plan for real.
preconditions: Causal model of target system available

parameters.name: cost_fraction
parameters.description: Share of real execution cost the simulation may consume before simulating is not worth it.

parameters.name: fidelity
parameters.description: Whether the causal graph models coarse dynamics or detailed ones.

parameters.name: steps
parameters.description: How far ahead the dry run looks.
